column5: Every HTTP request including denied requests produces one audit record with time; sequence; principal; role; method; path; status; allow/deny decision; duration and for raw UDS only the service identifier; request payloads; certificates and keys are never recorded

column10: Integrity only; an attacker with root access can regenerate the whole chain; see deviation DEV-SEC-08
